This repository contains Sight, a C++20 surgical image guidance and healthcare toolkit.

Follow the repository-wide guidance in `AGENTS.md`. Use the existing `.clang-tidy` configuration and preserve the project's object/service architecture, XML configuration conventions, signal/slot communication, and Doctest-based tests.

For a task specifically about creating or testing a service, consult `.github/prompts/create-service.prompt.md` for service-related tasks. The detailed service workflow is available at `.agents/skills/sight-service/SKILL.md`.
